newsitem.title: USA: Aquaterre withdraws from Doby George deal.
newsitem.headline: Aquaterre withdraws from Doby George deal.

text.p: Atlas Corp said Tuesday Aquaterre Mineral Development Ltd will not proceed with the purchase of the Atlas Doby George property located in Elko County, Nev.

Atlas granted Aquaterre an exclusive option in January to acquire the property on or before April 18. Aquaterre cited current market conditions as a determining factor in its decision to withdraw, Atlas said.
The company said the geologic resource at Doby George is estimated to contain 3.6 million tons of mineralized material at a grade of 0.06 ounce of gold per ton.
Atlas said it is assessing possible joint venture of the property as well as an outright sale.
